note: The shell could not reach any of these sites, so each table was extracted from the page text returned by a web fetch (a summary of the rendered page, not the raw HTML bytes). The CSV tables in this folder are the staged extraction; their sha256 values are recorded in docs/model/honors_validation.json. Every fact is cross-checked against a second source before it is shown.

nba_com_finals_mvp_history.note: Finals MVP by season, 1996-97 to 2025-26, with team names.

bbref_finals_mvp.note: Finals MVP with player ids and team abbreviations.

nba_com_pr_2025_26_awards.note: Official 2025-26 regular-season award winners and All-NBA, All-Defensive and All-Rookie teams. Winners only; voting results are not used.

bbref_awards_2026.note: MVP and Rookie of the Year plus the three team awards, with ids. Its Defensive Player, Sixth Man and Most Improved sections were empty when fetched.

wikipedia_2025_26_nba_season.note: Secondary source for the five individual awards, the champion and Finals result.

nba_com_season_recaps.note: Champion and Finals result for every season.

bbref_team_page_nyk_2026.note: Knicks 2025-26 season page: playoff record 16-3 and the title.

wikipedia_2026_nba_finals.note: 2026 Finals result. It lists players who appeared in the series, not a ring or roster list.

wikipedia_playoffs_and_season_pages.note: Playoff seeds from each season's playoff page (2003, 2009-2014, 2016-2026) or the standings table on the season page (1997-2002, 2004-2008, 2015). Published seeds are not always record order (for example division winners in 2004-2015). A secondary source, not the NBA's own media guide.

kaggle_nba_stats.note: All-Star selections and the awards for 1996-97 to 2024-25. Single source.

not_available: Ring recipients and full championship rosters: no reachable source lists them. Wikipedia's Finals pages list players who appeared in the series and name a few ring winners in prose only.
The NBA's own seed tables and its season-by-season home-court tiebreak rules were not reachable.
Raw page bytes: the shell has no route to these sites, so only extracted text could be staged.
